about.title: About Frpilot
about.subtitle: A lightweight, friendly visual client for frp
about.intro: Frpilot is a visual client for frp built with Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + TypeScript. Manage frpc versions, servers and tunnels through a friendly GUI — and say goodbye to hand-writing frpc.toml.

flow.step1Desc: Open "Download frpc", grab the build for your platform and architecture, or import a local one.
flow.step2Desc: Add the frps address, port and auth token under "Servers", then enable one of them.
flow.step3Desc: Create and enable the tunnels you need (TCP / HTTP, etc.) under "Tunnels".
flow.step4Desc: Head back to the "Dashboard" and start Frpc with a single click, watching live logs and status.
